title: Looks great! Edited*** What's up with the glue?
text:
Looks great! Edited*** What's up with the glue?. It looks just like the picture and quite possibly great for storing my teas, but I am concerned with the size since I wasn't sure it was going to be this big I have yet to actually store my teas in there so I can actually check if the sizing is correct or if it's too big since the box itself seemed a little big to me and what I wanted them for basically where I wanted to store it, I just hope it's not too much for my storage space and it actually works well. I will edit my review once I wash it and put it in place but it does look durable and arrived in good condition.

Edit* This thing had the weirdest sticker on top, that was difficult to remove even after washing it and letting it soak for a while and even when I went fully in myself just taking the glue off first of all and then some weird chemical or thing on it that came off the moment I started trying to take the glue off, it was so difficult and I have yet to clean the top completely, looks horrible. Aesthetically speaking it looks really bad, I am not even sure if I'll be able to completely clean it off at all, doesn't make me happy I removed one star.
